## Houston 1.0.1

A small update after 1.0.

### What's new

- **Your plan is always in view.** On Free, the bottom of the sidebar shows how much of your week you have used, with an Upgrade button that opens Billing. On your phone it sits in More.

### Fixes and polish

- **An edit you make to a routine is never undone** by your AI Employee saving its own change at the same moment.
- **Houston stays connected while it sits in the background**, instead of reconnecting every few minutes.
- **AI Employees you aren't using stay asleep** instead of being woken by the app in the background.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
